# RealTimeImageToEventConversion

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for converting standard image frames into event-based data streams in real time, enabling neuromorphic processing of conventional visual inputs. This bridges the gap between traditional imaging sensors and event-driven neuromorphic hardware, expanding the applicability of iNEST systems to standard visual data sources.
